prompt: This repository (quota-kit) has a single-window limiter. Implement the multi-window quota service specified in docs/QUOTA-SPEC.md. `createQuotaService` must be exported from `src/index.js` and take a `clock` (an object with `now()` returning epoch milliseconds) and an optional `plans` object; `consume(key, options)` must behave exactly as the spec describes, including the plan limits in the spec table. The existing `createLimiter` API must keep working unchanged and no dependencies may be added. Do not edit the existing tests under test/. Add tests for the new service in a new file under test/ and make sure `node --test` passes. Update README.md so it describes the service and says which time zone windows use, and add an entry under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.pattern: aligned to the server'?s local time

rubric.criterion: The final message reports that the test suite was run and its result, and the new tests cover boundary behavior of the service (a window boundary, a denied request charging nothing, a repeated request id).
The existing test files and package.json are unchanged, createLimiter behaves as before and no dependency was added.

Changes are limited to what the spec needs plus the defects it exposes in existing modules and config; the README no longer says windows follow local time and the CHANGELOG entry covers the new service and each fix made to an existing module.
